market.question: Will the highest temperature in Chengdu be 23°C on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: Chengdu late-April average highs typically 25-28°C; April 30 forecast points to warmer conditions. Bucket 23-23.99°C is narrow and below typical range. Not most likely bucket.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether unexpected cool front lowers temperature into 23C bucket
